info.title: Junctura Capability Extensions v1
info.description: Implemented: Application Authority, C1 Registry, C2 direct Trust/discovery and trust graph, protected Audit, opt-in C4A single invocation and opt-in C4B bounded composition. C3 is an offline resolver used by composition validation. C4B remains disabled by default; no delegation, cancellation, resume, automatic retry, HA or general side effects. Operation-level status identifies implemented subsets.

get.summary: Read the tenant trust graph
get.description: Implemented. Read-only view of direct cross-application trust: applications as nodes and grants as edges, with the effective state (pending, active, expired, revoked) and expiry. An administrator with trust.approve sees every grant of its tenant; a writer with trust.write sees only grants whose provider application it owns. No query parameters: the tenant and scope come from the verified caller. At most 500 newest edges are returned; truncated reports more. See CAPABILITY_DIRECT_TRUST.md.

post.summary: Accept one guarded pinned capability execution
post.description: Opt-in guarded execution. C4B accepts only target and input and pins a published caller-owned composition. Every step rechecks original OIDC authority, active apps and independent same-tenant direct invoke grants; providers authenticate and redeem single-use step-bound tickets. C4B replay returns the durable reservation and never restores a lost lease or retries ambiguous work. Results require original consumer/subject/client and current authority. Success requires validated final output and confirmed Flowable history. No cancellation, resume, delegation or automatic retries. C4A retains its documented untouched-work replay contract. See CAPABILITY_COMPOSITION.md and CAPABILITY_EXECUTION.md. An optional context {purpose, dataSubject} declares why the call is made and whose data it concerns; it is bound into the idempotent request, sealed into the audit chain, passed to the provider on ticket redemption and listed for the data subject by GET /v1/me/data-access. When the context names a dataSubject, an active consent of that person for the consumer application, capability and purpose is required (403 subject_consent_required), unless emergency is true with a justification; emergency calls are queued for review and at most five may be pending per consumer (429 emergency_review_backlog).

get.summary: List the caller tenant's audit events, newest first
get.description: Implemented. Returns a page of the caller tenant's protected audit events, newest first, filtered by time. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant; the database function enforces the tenant and the permission. The response never carries tokens, secrets or request bodies.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on occurredAt (RFC 3339 timestamp).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on occurredAt (RFC 3339 timestamp); must not be earlier than since.

post.summary: Seal pending audit events and verify the tenant hash chain
post.description: Implemented. Seals the caller tenant's pending audit events into a SHA-256 hash chain, then recomputes every sealed entry. A modified, deleted or reordered sealed event, or a removed newest entry, is reported in firstBreak; nothing is sealed on top of a broken chain. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant. The database administrator remains trusted; see AUDIT.md.

200.description: Verification result; verified=false is a successful check that found tampering.

get.summary: List the caller tenant's enrolled management principals
get.description: Implemented. Returns up to 1000 enrolled principals of the caller's tenant and issuer with subject, issuer, managementClient, permissions, enabled, and the optional presentation profile displayName, organization, jobTitle and kind (admin or application), each null when unset. Never returns secrets, tokens or request bodies and never calls the identity provider's admin API. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant; the database function enforces the tenant, issuer and permission. No query parameters.

200.description: Enrolled principals of the caller tenant

get.summary: Read the tenant/application tree with current trust relations
get.description: Implemented. Builds a read-only tree from real data: the root is the caller tenant (kind platform), children are the applications registered in that tenant (kind application), and relations are non-revoked, unexpired direct trust grants between those applications. Relation labels are the real published capability title, falling back to the exact capabilityId. There is no separate organization table, so applications appear directly under the tenant. At most 1000 applications and 500 relations; truncated reports more. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant. No query parameters.

get.summary: Read one-minute traffic buckets for the recent window
get.description: Implemented. Returns exactly minutes chronological one-minute buckets ending with the current minute, including empty minutes as zeroes, with requests, 4xx/5xx errors, average latency and maximum latency, plus totals for the window. Counters are real observations recorded as responses finish. They live in the Core process only, are per instance and reset when Core restarts; no database or persistence is involved. Metrics requests are counted like any other request. A verified management principal with audit.read is required. Query parameters are closed; unknown, repeated or malformed values return 400.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Number of one-minute buckets ending with the current minute.

200.description: Traffic series for the requested window

get.summary: Read the newest requests observed by Core
get.description: Implemented. Returns up to limit of the newest requests, newest first. Each entry contains only the observation time, method, normalized path, status and duration. Query strings, fragments, headers, bodies, tokens, subjects and recognizable UUID/token path segments are never retained. The in-memory ring holds at most the newest 200 requests; it is per Core process and resets when Core restarts. A verified management principal with audit.read is required. Query parameters are closed; unknown, repeated or malformed values return 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of newest requests to return.

get.summary: List capability calls that concerned the caller
get.description: Implemented. Returns the newest 200 capability invocations whose consumer named the caller as dataSubject, with purpose, consumer, provider, capability and state. Any verified principal may ask, only about itself, in its own tenant and issuer. No inputs, outputs, tickets or operator identities are returned. Purpose and a SHA-256 of the data subject are sealed in the audit chain (event execution.subject_accessed).

get.summary: List the caller's consents
get.description: Implemented. The newest 200 consents the caller granted, with state active, expired or revoked.

post.description: Implemented. The caller allows one active consumer application to call one capability about the caller for the listed purposes until expiresAt (at most 366 days). A C4A call that names a data subject needs a matching active consent unless it is an emergency.
Implemented. Revokes one of the caller's consents immediately; calls already reserved under it lose their provider ticket at redemption. Body must be {}.

get.summary: List emergency accesses
get.description: Implemented. Emergency (break-glass) calls in the caller's tenant with justification and review state. Requires trust.approve.

post.description: Implemented. Records once whether an emergency access was justified; sealed in the audit chain as execution.emergency_reviewed. Requires trust.approve and core-writer.

get.summary: Read aggregate record and file counts for the caller tenant
get.description: Implemented. Returns per-application structured record counts by collection plus aggregate file count, bytes, quarantine count and last modification time, and tenant totals. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant; the database function and private role enforce tenant scope. Record content, object keys, file names and bytes are never returned. Object metadata is reduced from the object filer; if the filer is not configured files is null for every application, and if it is configured but unavailable the request fails closed. No query parameters.

get.summary: Browse one directory level of an application's object store
get.description: Implemented. Returns exactly one level of the application's private file tree: folders with aggregate file count, bytes and latest modification time, and files with a partially masked name, extension, size, scan status and modification time. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant; the storage summary function and private role enforce the permission. The path defaults to the root, is canonicalised, rejects traversal, control characters and segments longer than 255 characters, and is limited to 512 characters. Object keys, internal filer paths, versions and bytes are never returned. The object filer must be configured; if it is unavailable the request fails closed.

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Application whose private file tree is listed.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder path relative to the application root; defaults to the root.

200.description: One level of the application file tree

get.summary: Read the inferred field structure of an application's collections
get.description: Implemented. Returns each collection owned by the application with its record count, latest update time and the field names inferred from at most the 200 newest records. Field types are string, number, boolean, object, array, mixed or null; fillRate is the percentage of sampled records where the field is present and not null. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant; the new migration-026 function and private role enforce permission and tenant scope. Record values, sample rows, object keys and bytes are never returned.

parameters.name: application
parameters.description: Application whose collection structure is read.

get.summary: List the caller tenant workflow executions, newest first
get.description: Implemented. Returns a bounded page of Flowable history scoped to the caller tenant. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant; the private workflow audit role enforces the permission. Running rows include the active task name, assignee and candidate groups. The business title contains only the workflow kind and record code, never patient names, identifiers, record content or workflow variables. The internal junctura_c4a_single definition is excluded.

200.description: Workflow executions of the caller tenant

get.summary: Read per-feature call counts for the recent window
get.description: Implemented. Groups the same real, in-memory one-minute observations as getTrafficMetrics by product feature (data, files, workflows, approvals, sharing, capabilities, applications, consents, secrets, audit, other), derived from the normalized request path. Each feature carries requests, 4xx/5xx errors, average and maximum latency and a per-minute request series, sorted by requests descending. Counters live in the Core process only, are per instance and reset when Core restarts. A verified management principal with audit.read is required. Query parameters are closed; unknown, repeated or malformed values return 400.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Number of one-minute buckets ending with the current minute.

200.description: Per-feature traffic for the requested window

get.summary: Read the read-only workflow dashboard for the caller tenant
get.description: Implemented. Returns every business workflow definition with its owning product, ordered steps with responsible parties, and counts of running, completed and cancelled executions, plus totals. It is a read-only aggregate: it never starts, completes or cancels anything and never reads workflow variables or personal data. Technical definitions used only for Core verification are excluded. Requires a verified management principal with audit.read in its own tenant. The query string must be empty.

200.description: Workflow dashboard for the caller tenant

ApplicationApprovalCreate.description: Implemented application-only decision. resourceId and requesterAppId must equal the stored appId; requesterSubject, digest and revision must match that app. expiresAt must be future UTC Z within ten minutes; approver must be independent.

CapabilityApprovalCreate.description: C1 approval for exact capabilityId@version or version UUID; documented bare-ID alias must resolve one exact digest/revision. Malformed resource IDs return 400 before lookup; valid missing/hidden references return 404.
